fallback.text: The walls were black, like some long, dormant magma chamber. But even starting from a natural cavern, it would have been a monumental labor to bring it to its current state.

female-0.label: female, warm
female-0.description: A warm, conversational female voice used for characters like Farrah, Gabrielle, Sophie, and Thel, delivering dialogue with a calm and casual tone.

clip.text: There are villages like the one we stayed in all through the region. From here it all gets taken south and shipped downriver on barges.

female-1.label: female, expressive
female-1.description: An expressive female voice with a wider pitch range, used for characters like Phoebe, Gabrielle, and Sophie, often conveying casual or intense moods.

clip.text: Magic Society project that these people took over. That's some serious clout. Yes, it is.

female-2.label: female, authoritative
female-2.description: A clear, slightly higher-pitched female voice, primarily used for Belinda, delivering instructions and strategic dialogue with a calm but firm tone.

clip.text: The protection I set up in here will hide your aura so long as you're in this shed, but you can't stay here.

male-0.label: male, casual
male-0.description: A casual, mid-range male voice used for characters like Jason, Clive, and Humphrey, delivering dialogue in a relaxed and conversational manner.

male-2.label: male, serious
male-2.description: A serious, calm male voice, primarily used for Rufus and Vincent, delivering dialogue with a composed and instructional tone.

clip.text: It's a delicate process, though. Changes in the ambient magic can ruin whole batches, which is why they have farms out here. No activity, no life. Very stable ambient magic.

narration-0.label: calm narration
narration-0.description: A low-pitched, calm narration voice used for descriptive passages and general storytelling, maintaining a steady and quiet tone.

clip.text: As the wind faded, Jason looked around at the leeches cast as far as dozens of metres away.

narration-1.label: tense narration
narration-1.description: A slightly higher-pitched, tense narration voice used for more intense or suspenseful descriptive passages, conveying urgency and focus.

clip.text: After a few attempts to break the surprisingly sturdy glass, he remembered the key ring he had looted from the dead body.

narration-2.label: action narration
narration-2.description: A high-intensity, fast-paced narration voice used for action sequences, delivering dialogue with urgency and energy.

clip.text: Jason maintained distance, but landed an embarrassing few meters to the left of the tortoise.

narration-3.label: system announcement
narration-3.description: A distinct, higher-pitched narration voice used for in-world system announcements, such as item descriptions and ability details, with a clear and mechanical tone.

clip.text: Attacks ignore Bronze Rank damage reduction and poison resistance. Umbral Snake Venom. Damage over time, poison stacking. Inflicts ongoing necrotic damage until poison is cleansed.
